title: A web page that contains unusual WebGPU content loaded into the GPU GLES render process can trigger a OOB read and/or…
description: A vulnerability exists in the GPU GLES user-space shared library where loading unusual WebGPU content into the GPU GLES render process can cause an out-of-bounds (OOB) read and/or write crash. On some platforms, if the graphics workload process has system privileges, this flaw could potentially be leveraged for further exploitation on the device.
